# Timbrana

> Timbrana is construction project management software focused on project awareness for general contractors. It connects field activity, decisions, responsibility and follow-through so superintendents and project managers can see what needs attention, what is waiting and what happens next.

## Comparisons
- https://timbrana.com/procore-alternative.html — Honest scope comparison for teams considering Procore alternatives
- https://timbrana.com/buildertrend-alternative.html — Honest scope comparison for teams considering Buildertrend alternatives

## Product boundaries
Timbrana focuses on project execution and awareness. It is not positioned as accounting, estimating or payroll software and does not claim to be a feature-for-feature replacement for broad all-in-one construction platforms.
